title: A failed data fetch shows the fetching-error toast which auto-fades after 5 seconds
custom_preconds: 1. You can interrupt the network (browser dev tools offline mode).
custom_steps:
1. Go offline, then open the report (or change a filter to force a re-fetch).
2. Read the toast and time how long it stays.
custom_expected:
1. An error toast is shown: "An error occurred while fetching the report data."
2. The toast auto-fades after 5 seconds.
